# Phase-0 Redistributable Fixtures

These fixtures were written for the crexx-rag Phase-0 diagnostic programme on
2026-07-28. They are synthetic, contain no private or secret material, and do
not copy the archived Project Gutenberg corpus. They may be redistributed under
the repository's licence.

The generic IT set is version 1. It contains deliberately small source
artifacts for exact keyword/keyphrase retrieval, aliases, semantic paraphrases,
ambiguity, chronology, multiple independent support, source stance, replacement
and deletion, and directed paths. `it-held-out.md` is reserved for the blinded
quality protocol and must not be included in prompt exemplars.

The Scotland-shaped set preserves only the problem shapes learned from the
archived qualitative exercise: name/place/title ambiguity, direct phrase versus
inference, narrative versus locator evidence, chronology assembled from several
passages, source-attributed stance, graph adjacency that is not a claim, and an
explicit evidence gap. All people, places, institutions, dates, and events are
fictional.

`cases.jsonl` is an inventory, not an answer key. Judgement labels and blinded
answers live under the dated evidence directory.
